# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.0.0-beta.3

- A first-launch welcome explains how to connect a rekordbox USB, export stems, and prepare player firmware updates.
- A What’s new window shows the changes the first time you open the app after an update.
- Clearer app and firmware update notices take you directly to the update controls.
- The Firmware page shows what the latest version changes and fixes. Available app updates show their release notes in Settings.
